body_markdown:
*Ready-to-trade portfolios give U.S. investors access to themes ranging from cybersecurity, to artificial intelligence, nuclear energy, or American manufacturing*


**November 10, 2026** — etoro, the trading and investing platform, today announced the launch of Smart Portfolios for users in the United States. These ready-to-trade portfolios bundle stocks and ETFs around defined market themes and methodologies, giving retail investors diversified, long-term exposure with a low minimum investment, without management fees, performance fees, advisory fees, or lock-up periods.*


Once a user chooses a Smart Portfolio that aligns with their goals, etoro manages ongoing maintenance, such as rebalancing. Transparency is central to the experience, investors can see individual holdings’ portfolio weights, price and historical performance, and gain an understanding of the strategy behind the portfolio.


**Alain Tennekoon, Head of etoro US, said** :


*“* *With Smart Portfolios, retail investors have a simple, transparent, and diversified way to invest in industries with long-term growth potential. Individual market leaders will come and go, but the broader trends driving these industries can continue for years. Smart Portfolios allow investors to participate in those trends without having to constantly figure out who the next winner will be.”*


**Smart Portfolios available to U.S. investors focus on the following themes, among others:**


- [AI Revolution US:](https://www.etoro.com/smartportfolios/ai-revolution-us) Companies developing and applying artificial intelligence, including automation providers and the data centers supporting AI infrastructure.


- [CyberSecurity US](https://www.etoro.com/smartportfolios/cybersecurity-us) **:** Companies working to protect networks, data and devices as digital threats continue to evolve.


- [NuclearFuture US](https://www.etoro.com/smartportfolios/nuclearfuture-us) : Uranium miners, nuclear utilities, and companies that build and service nuclear reactors.


- [SpaceTech US](https://www.etoro.com/smartportfolios/spacetech-us) **:** Companies involved in aerospace, rocket launches, satellites, and navigation.


- [MadeinAmerica US](https://www.etoro.com/smartportfolios/madeinamerica-us) **:** U.S.-based industrial, defense, manufacturing, and infrastructure companies.


Additional Smart Portfolios provide exposure to more than 25 global investment themes across technology and innovation, energy and commodities, income, the core U.S. economy and consumer trends including: Bitcoin, semiconductors, fintech, gold, renewable energy, dividend stocks, real estate, gaming, and online shopping.
